title: The emergency goal fallback is never saved, so it fires and logs an error every minute
current: When a queued goal post has no usable goal in Redis, the updater computes an emergency goal from the subscriber count, renders the post with it, and logs subscriber_goal_emergency_fallback at error. Nothing persists the recovered goal or stops the cycle.
evidence: The r/SubGoal logs on 2026-11-27 show the same subscriber_goal_emergency_fallback for t3_1xstm2j every minute (part of R-W6-01). Viewers see a plausible but invented goal.
outcome: Observed every minute for one post in r/SubGoal (2026-11-27), alongside R-W6-01.
investigate: Should the recovered goal be saved once (with its source recorded), or should the post be retired when its data is gone?
Is the emergency goal shown to viewers marked as estimated?

criticality.why: A repeating error and invented goal numbers, though logged.
